cases.name: doc_ends_with_short_bullet_after_rich_block
cases.$comment: REQUIRED case: last entry is a SHORT bullet following a rich block. Verifies (a) the rich block's trailing fence blank IS present internally, AND (b) the doc gets NO spurious final newline (short-ending). Sort within Sales: 'a short' < 'rich narrative ...'? cases.name: mixed_element_type_siblings_under_one_parent
cases.$comment: Siblings of DIFFERENT element types under one Domain. Ordering is by the TYPE-PREFIXED section-path label (lowercased, element-wise) on BOTH sides, NOT the bare element names. Domain-direct input sorts first (shortest path is a prefix). Pinned order: domain-direct, Product: zebra, Relationship: a.b→c.d, Subdomain: aardvark.
